#!/bin/sh
# TH Bootloader (TWIN-62) 构建、16KB/236KB 边界门禁与宿主机单元测试脚本
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

echo "=== [1/4] Cross-compile TH Bootloader & check 16KB Flash / 48KB SRAM budget (S01/S02) ==="
make clean all
test -f build/bootloaderth.bin
BIN_SIZE="$(stat -c%s build/bootloaderth.bin)"
echo "bootloaderth.bin size: ${BIN_SIZE} bytes (limit: 16384 bytes)"
test "$BIN_SIZE" -le 16384

# 校验链接器对超过 16KB 镜像的硬拦截能力 (S01 负例)
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys, tempfile, os

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpd:
    over_c = os.path.join(tmpd, "oversize.c")
    with open(over_c, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write('__attribute__((used, section(".init"))) const unsigned char g_over[16384] = {1};\n')
    over_o = os.path.join(tmpd, "oversize.o")
    subprocess.run(
        ["arm-none-eabi-gcc", "-mcpu=cortex-m4", "-mthumb", "-mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16", "-mfloat-abi=hard", "-c", over_c, "-o", over_o],
        check=True,
    )
    objs = [os.path.join("build", fn) for fn in os.listdir("build") if fn.endswith(".o")] + [over_o]
    res = subprocess.run(
        [
            "arm-none-eabi-gcc",
            "-mcpu=cortex-m4",
            "-mthumb",
            "-mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16",
            "-mfloat-abi=hard",
            "-specs=nano.specs",
            "-specs=nosys.specs",
            "-Tldscripts/AT32A423xC_FLASH.ld",
            "-Wl,--gc-sections",
            *objs,
            "-o",
            os.path.join(tmpd, "over.elf"),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if res.returncode == 0:
        print("[FAIL] Oversize 16KB link test unexpectedly succeeded!", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("[PASS] S01 linker overflow gate rejected >16KB image with exit code", res.returncode)
PY

echo "=== [2/4] Check tools/pack_firmware.py 236KB (241,664B) boundary gate (S03) ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys, tempfile, os

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpd:
    for sz, expect_ok in [(241663, True), (241664, True), (241665, False), (240 * 1024, False)]:
        in_p = os.path.join(tmpd, f"in_{sz}.bin")
        out_p = os.path.join(tmpd, f"out_{sz}.bin")
        with open(in_p, "wb") as f:
            f.write(b"\x5A" * sz)
        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tools/pack_firmware.py", in_p, out_p], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if expect_ok and res.returncode != 0:
            print(f"[FAIL] Expected {sz}B to succeed, got rc={res.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        if expect_ok and os.path.getsize(out_p) != sz + 128:
            print(f"[FAIL] Packed size mismatch for {sz}B", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        if (not expect_ok) and res.returncode == 0:
            print(f"[FAIL] Expected {sz}B (>236KB) to be rejected!", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
print("[PASS] S03 pack_firmware.py 236KB boundary checks (241663/241664/241665/245760) passed!")
PY

echo "=== [3/4] Run host unit tests for TH Bootloader MiniMCProto v2.0 state machine ==="
mkdir -p build/host_tests
gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -DIAP_HOST_TEST -DDEBUG_LOG_ENABLE=0 \
    -Iinc src/iap.c src/flash.c tests/test_th_boot_ota.c -o build/host_tests/test_th_boot_ota
./build/host_tests/test_th_boot_ota
rm -rf build/host_tests

echo "=== [4/4] Verify C function length (<=50 lines) and parameter count (<=4) gate (S04) ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, sys

files = ["src/iap.c", "src/flash.c", "src/main.c", "src/usart.c", "tests/test_th_boot_ota.c"]
func_pat = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_][\w\s\*]*\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(([^;]*)\)\s*\{", re.M)

for path in files:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()
    lines = text.splitlines()
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if line.endswith("{") or (i + 1 < len(lines) and lines[i + 1].strip() == "{"):
            sig = line if line.endswith("{") else (line + " " + lines[i + 1].strip())
            if "(" in sig and ")" in sig and not sig.startswith(("if", "for", "while", "switch", "typedef", "struct", "enum")):
                args_str = sig[sig.find("(") + 1 : sig.rfind(")")].strip()
                params = 0 if args_str in ("", "void") else len(args_str.split(","))
                if params > 4:
                    print(f"[FAIL] {path}:{i+1} has {params} parameters (>4): {sig}", file=sys.stderr)
                    sys.exit(1)
                brace_start = i if line.endswith("{") else i + 1
                depth = 0
                end_line = brace_start
                for j in range(brace_start, len(lines)):
                    depth += lines[j].count("{") - lines[j].count("}")
                    if depth == 0:
                        end_line = j
                        break
                body_len = end_line - i + 1
                if body_len > 50:
                    print(f"[FAIL] {path}:{i+1} function length {body_len} > 50: {sig}", file=sys.stderr)
                    sys.exit(1)
                i = end_line + 1
                continue
        i += 1
print("[PASS] S04 all C functions in boot/bootloaderth satisfy <=50 lines and <=4 parameters!")
PY
